page.meta_description: Weyland-Yutani is the corporation that owns the Nostromo's mission, plants Ash, and treats human crews as expendable next to a xenomorph specimen. Related…
page.content:
The Company that wants the organism as a weapon.

How Weyland-Yutani connects

  • Character: Ash — Ash secretly serves Weyland-Yutani over the crew.
  • Character: Peter Weyland — Peter Weyland founds the company that becomes Weyland-Yutani.
  • Character: David — David is Weyland's android on the Prometheus mission.
  • Concept: Xenomorph — The Company wants the xenomorph as a biological weapon.
  • Faction: Nostromo crew — The Nostromo crew works a Company towing contract.

What is Weyland-Yutani?

Weyland-Yutani is the corporation that owns the Nostromo's mission, plants Ash, and treats human crews as expendable next to a xenomorph specimen.

Key threads lead to Ash, Peter Weyland, David, Xenomorph and Nostromo crew.
